dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.scopeDetail: One download for all your workspaces on this device.
dictation.privacy: Speech is processed only on this device.
dictation.waitingDetail: Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to download. Mobile data is not used.
dictation.preparingDetail: The download is complete. Dictation will be available when preparation finishes.
dictation.storageFailed: Not enough space to finish the download.
dictation.downloadRecovery: Check your connection, then try again.
dictation.storageRecovery: Free up space on this device, then try again.
dictation.permissionDetail: Allow microphone access in the system prompt to start recording.
dictation.deniedDetail: Allow Situate to use the microphone in your device’s privacy settings, then try dictating again.
dictation.noSpeech: No speech was recognized. Try dictating again.
dictation.failed: Dictation couldn’t be transcribed. Please dictate again.
dictation.interrupted: Dictation was interrupted. The recording was discarded. Please dictate again.
dictation.inserted: Text added to your draft. Review it before sending.
dictation.busySend: Finish dictation before sending this draft.
dictation.offline: Dictation works offline. Sending a message needs an AI connection.
dictation.leaveRecording: Leaving now discards the recording. Your typed draft stays.
dictation.leaveTranscribing: Transcription is still running. Leaving now discards this dictation. Your typed draft stays.
dictation.completedDetail: The text is now in your draft. You can stay to review it or continue.
